messages:
carla: Noticed a parity gap in sampleapps — JS/Go expose typed exceptions (RateLimitError.retryAfterMs) but Python/Rust samples yield generic APIError/HTTPError. Confusing for onboarding.

ben: Which endpoint? /v1/generate sync or streaming?

carla: /v1/generate sync. JS example raises RateLimitError with .code='rate_limit' and .retryAfterMs=1200. Python currently just does response.raise_for_status() -> HTTPError with no structured fields.

amira: We should standardize a server error envelope and have SDKs normalize legacy shapes into typed exceptions. Minimal envelope: ```json
{"error":{"message":"Too many requests","code":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":1200,"retryable":true}}
```

ben: SDKs should implement NormalizeError(resp) -> typed subclass (RateLimitError, AuthError, PermissionError, NotFoundError, ServerError) attaching .code, .retry_after_ms, .hint, .meta, .http_status.

carla: UX notes: keep `message` end-user safe; put internal details in `.meta`. For streaming, emit `on_error(err, partial_text)` with normalized err and partial content.

amira: Rollout plan: 1) Server starts emitting envelope for new responses; 2) SDKs add normalization layer; 3) provide `normalize_errors` opt-in in a minor release, flip default in next major; 4) add sampleapps e2e against fixture server that returns both legacy and envelope forms.

ben: I'll own Go + JS tests and sampleapp harness. ETA: next week.

carla: I'll own Python adapter and docs stub. Will include examples catching by class and checking `err.code`. ETA: next Wed.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-1702: "Error envelope + SDK normalization parity e2e" assigned to ben,carla. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1702

ben: Thanks — will add CI assertion that legacy & envelope responses yield the same exception class and attribute values. :thumbsup:

carla: I'll paste minimal reproducible curl + sampleapp logs into the ticket.

amira: We'll review in SDK sync on Thursday.

ben: Closing loop for now.
